info.title: Chromium NX
info.author: shodowlo
info.description: Full Chromium web browser for Switch
info.details:
The Chromium web browser as a homebrew app for the Nintendo Switch. Debian's stock arm64 Chromium runs on Linux as a library (LKL). Experimental.

What's in it:
- Tabs, a lasting profile, sound, YouTube and videos
- Launcher with search bar, YouTube for TVs and your own sites
- 1080p docked, 720p handheld, full screen, portrait mode
- Touch, USB keyboard
- Downloads to the SD card

AI use: Mostly AI-generated.
